profile.summary:
Over 10 years experience as a full-stack software engineer

Back-End Development
- Languages: Node, Java, PHP, Ruby, Python, C, Bash/Shell
- Libraries & frameworks: Express, Socket.IO, Rails, Sinatra, Spring Boot, Jackson
- Testing: JUnit, PHPUnit, RSpec
- Data: Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, Looker, Apache Presto, Apache Druid
- ORMs: Sequelize, Bookshelf, Mongoose, Hibernate, Active Record

Front-End Development
- Languages: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript
- Libraries & frameworks: React, Redux, Angular, Vue, Next, Ember, Lodash, Underscore, D3
- Testing: Mocha, Chai, Karma, Jasmine, Sinon, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Protractor
- Module bundlers & loaders: Webpack, Parcel, Browserify, Require, SystemJS
- CSS preprocessors: Sass, LESS, PostCSS
